name: Galatea
ability:
Yoki Manipulation
Wide Range Yoki Sensing
Soul Link
appearance:
Galatea has silver eyes and long, straight, flowing blonde hair. She wears the standard Claymore uniform. She is the tallest known female Claymore and exceptionally beautiful, frequently seen wearing a smug expression.
Height: 185 cm (6 ft 0.83 in)
As Sister Latea, Galatea looks mostly the same save for her white eyes, which now have corneal scars, and a jagged scar across her face, marking the wound that destroyed her sight. In some pages, the scars disappear, possibly a drawing mistake by Nohiro Yagi. It is also possible that this is not an actual scar, but a commonly used artistic stylization of blindness that is often mistaken as a scar.
